description: This PHP class 'LeaveRequestCommentDao' provides data access methods for handling leave request comments and leave comments within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for searching, counting, saving comments, and retrieving leave requests and leaves by ID.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for leave request comments and leave comments, providing search, save, and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: searchLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Searches for leave request comments based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveRequestCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave request comments matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveRequestCommentPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for leave request comments based on filter parameters.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Persists a leave request comment to the database.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a leave request by ID (deprecated).

methods.name: searchLeaveComments
methods.description: Searches for leave comments based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveCommentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave comments matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveCommentPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for leave comments based on filter parameters.

methods.name: saveLeaveComment
methods.description: Persists a leave comment to the database.
